text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With summer training camp soon coming to 
an end, a certain change began to show—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: An offer... you say?
choice_data_list:
Addressed to local idol Hokko Tarumae, of 
course.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lately, Hokko Tarumae had begun receiving 
all sorts of offers, such as 'Please 
appear on our show as a local idol.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While this is indeed a chance to raise her 
profile, considering Hokko Tarumae has her 
sights set on the Champions Cup—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...No, I want to take it!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Of course, not everything all at once; 
we'll prioritize. On top of that, Trainer, 
I'd like you to check if anything seems 
unreasonable.
choice_data_list: I don't mind, but are you all right?
I don't mind, but are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine. My top priority right now is the 
Champions Cup. I have no intention of 
wavering on that.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Still, by raising my profile as a local 
idol here, I want to add to my reach and 
impact for the Champions Cup!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
So to speak, it's a two-stage approach. If 
we do that, I'm sure the Champions Cup 
will become the breakthrough that leads 
everyone to Tomakomai...!
choice_data_list: ...If that's how it is, got it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I understood Hokko Tarumae's thoughts 
well. All that was left was to search 
together for a way to fulfill her wishes 
to the utmost extent.
choice_data_list:
Alright, first let's sort through all 
these requests.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with the summer training camp coming 
to an end, as we prepared to head back to 
the academy—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...I feel like this summer training camp 
was really intensive.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Still, we can't let our guard down. The 
Champions Cup, plus the local idol gigs... 
We've got so much to do...!
choice_data_list:
Let's keep working hard together once 
we're back at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Classmate Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae~, sorry, do you have a sec~? This 
kid says she lost something! Help us look 
for it~!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! —I'm sorry, Trainer! My classmate 
is calling me, so I gotta run!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
We're taking separate buses back, right! 
See you at the academy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After seeing Hokko Tarumae off as she ran 
toward her classmates, I was about to 
board the bus back early when—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —Tarumae-chan's Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to spring this on you out of 
nowhere! Do you have a second?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Just Falco is fine♪ Also, if you act that 
surprised, it kinda hurts my feelings☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, it was true that I was shocked. 
Even though she has stepped down from the 
front lines, she is still a living legend 
of an Umamusume who leaves a powerful 
impression of standing at the very top.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
There's still time before the bus leaves, 
right? I was hoping we could chat for a 
bit—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I arrived at the woods near the 
training camp with Smart Falcon—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae-chan, you've been doing so amazing 
lately! Actually, I—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I check all of Tarumae-chan's social media 
posts! We even follow each other back!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Her dance videos and everything are so 
cute♪ The Tarumae Challenge livestream 
right before the training camp was super 
fun, too!
choice_data_list: You were watching me that closely, huh?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I've been watching veeeery closely! 
Both as a local idol—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: As a dirt Umamusume, too, that is!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —Good luck in the Champions Cup.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I saw Tarumae-chan post on Umatter this 
morning saying she's aiming to run, so I 
just wanted to share those words with 
you."
choice_data_list: Thank you. Tarumae will be happy too.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, no, no! The one I wanted to cheer on 
was you, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Please watch over Tarumae-chan closely, 
okay? Even closer and more attentively 
than I do!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If Tarumae-chan keeps aiming for the 
"center" like this—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Because one day... you'll have to face 
something."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: It's Falco☆ ...Thanks for listening to me!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Then I'm heading back to the bus first! 
See you later, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I could ask what she truly meant by 
those words, Smart Falcon dashed away—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp ended, and the next 
stage was about to begin—
